subject: Example of writing Renjin extension packages

messages.author: 4c754215ad9820f5
messages.subject: Example of writing Renjin extension packages
parts:
Hi,

I have just started with writing extensions for Renjin. I tried to follow document of http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/writing-renjin-extensions.html, but got stuck with some errors. 

In the src/main/java/MyFunc.java, I put in a dummy class:

package com.acme.foobar;

public class MyFunc {
  public static boolean myFunc() {
    return true;
  }
}

In the src/main/R/myFunc.R, I would like to define a function calling the myFunc() in java:

import(com.acme.foobar.MyFunc)

my.func <- function() {
  MyFunc$myFunc()
}

I export the my.func in NAMESPACE, and I tried to load and use my package like:

library(com.acme.foobar)
my.func()

However, it gave error message of :
ERROR: ExternalPtr is NULL for name myFunc

Is there anything I have done miserably wrong here? Is there any quick examples of writing an extension?

Thanks so much!

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Example of writing Renjin extension packages
parts:
Hi Andy,
I suspect there's a problem serializing the reference to the MyFunc class object: as a top-level statement, it will be evaluated at packaging time and its result, the external pointer, will be serialized to the jar file and reloaded at runtime. It would be great if you could file an issue for this, but in the meantime, can you add the class instead to your NAMESPACE file?

Like so:
importClass(com.acme.foobar)

See an example here:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/6051ea593040c612239dd9078b523406543c301d/packages/stats/NAMESPACE#L565 

Best,
Alex
